messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert — CedarBridge (enterprise) dedicated-eu: sudden spike in 5xx responses from model-proxy, autoscaler throttle events observed. Pager: sam. Logs attached.
sam: Acknowledged. Pulling traces and recent deploys. Dropping into #eng-sre for deeper dive. @marco you free to grab this if it's infra?
marco: On it. I can see elevated upstream timeouts to model-runtime. Quick check: `kubectl get pods -n cedar-bridge` shows restarts on model-proxy-*. Tail-ing logs now.
marco: ```
2026-03-17T12:02:10Z model-proxy ERROR upstream request timeout id=rt-9f3
2026-03-17T12:02:11Z model-proxy WARN backend queue length=312
2026-03-17T12:02:12Z autoscaler INFO scale_decision=throttle reason=insufficient-alloc
```
marco: Looks like a scaling stall + upstream timeouts. Could be a node placement / quota hit in eu-west-2. Asking cloud to confirm available GPU capacity.
leah: Heads-up to CSMs: CedarBridge is on a Dedicated monthly commitment with SLA. Need a tailored customer notification ASAP. Primary contacts listed below — use the "enterprise-tailored" template as base. Also coordinate account-team comms.
leah: CedarBridge contact routing:
- primary: caroline.m@cedarbridge.com
- engineering escalation: eng-oncall@cedarbridge.com
- legal/comms: ethan.k@cedarbridge.com
nina: Draft status page + customer message suggestion:
- Status page short: "We are investigating increased error rates impacting inference for CedarBridge on our dedicated EU cluster. Engineers are actively mitigating."
- Customer email draft:

"Hi Caroline / CedarBridge team —

We’re investigating an issue affecting inference latency and error rates on your dedicated EU cluster. Our engineers have identified upstream timeouts and are working on autoscaler and capacity checks. We’ll follow up within 30 minutes with an update and next steps. Apologies for the disruption — we’re treating this as a P1 for your account.

Best,
Redwood Inference — Incident Response"

nina: Add note to call out: potential short-term fallback options (route to dedicated-burst pool or temporary lower-precision model) and estimated ETA for next update (~30m).
sam: I will post the status page update and ping the account team. If cloud confirms capacity issue, we'll open a capacity emergency with infra and trigger burst fallback. I'll hold on the customer send until we confirm ETA. @leah please prep the tailored notify and have comms ready.
status-bot: Posted status page update: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/cedarbridge-2026-03-17 (edited) :white_check_mark:
marco: Cloud confirms two pending GPU allocations failed for eu-west-2 due to spot reclaim. Working with infra to reprovision from on-demand pool now. Triggering rollout to fallback model-quant profile to reduce memory and get node fit.
leah: Prepared customer message in Google Drive (link) and Cc list. Ready to send once you give GO, sam. I'll include suggested mitigations and our support hotline.
sam: GO in 10 if we have fallback route up. Handoff note: I'm oncall for next 15m, then handing to marco if still active. Key actions:
- marco: finish fallback rollout + monitor 5xx rate
- leah: queue customer email and prepare account update
- nina: prepare post-incident RCA template and impact severity
- status-bot: schedule status updates every 15m until resolved
sam: :hourglass_flowing_sand: starting monitoring, will update in 10.
status-bot: Scheduled recurring update at +15m intervals. Next update at 12:17Z.
marco: Fallback rollout started. Applying quantized-model flag to cedar-bridge-prod via patch:
```
kubectl patch deploy model-runtime -n cedar-bridge --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"quantize":"true"}}}}}'
```
marco: Rolling pods now, watching 5xx.
marco: 12:07Z — 5xx rate down 60% from peak. Observability shows request latency improving. Continuing to monitor.
sam: Thanks. If trend holds, we'll mark a customer update with ETA ~20-30m and avoid pager escalation. Keep posting updates here.
leah: Sending tailored customer notice now (sent at 12:10Z). Copying inbound and escalation contacts. Template included brief mitigation steps and expected next update in 20 minutes. :thumbsup:
sam: Handing to marco at 12:15Z for post-mitigation monitoring. Leaving these notes in incident doc. :white_check_mark:
marco: Acknowledged. Will close once 5xx rate stable <1% for 30m and confirm no queued retries. Will post final status and CTA for RCA.
status-bot: Final interim update posted: "Mitigation in progress; error rates improving. Next update in 20 minutes or earlier." Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/cedarbridge-2026-03-17/update-2
